object.name: potted calathea with pink-striped dark leaves
object.description: Small calathea plant in a glossy metallic purple plastic tapered pot with a stepped rim. Large rounded dark green-black leaves with thin magenta-pink stripes along the midrib and near the edges, burgundy undersides, a rolled new leaf at the center, a dried brown leaf sheath near the base, dark soil visible at the top of the pot.

evidence.location_in_image: right half of the board, center-right of the frame
